hilarious, wild ending courtesy an awesome effort by the raptors' backend of bench to only lose by 6... luka was too much on the night with 45pts 15reb 6ast 5stl (7to), +27 in his 35 minutes

kessler's size was a huge problem
It was nice to see him find his shot. Hasn’t been there all year, so if he can be that guy we just saw at the end, the Raptors offence will be so much better.

Final:
Raptors 125
Lakers 131

The Lakers won 131-125 over the Toronto Raptors to move to 5-2.

Luka Doncic's now totally final line was 45 points (12-for-23 shooting, eight 3-pointers), 15 rebounds, six assists, five steals and a trio of drawn charges.

Story to come.

Raptors to start the season...

With Kawhi: 2-0
Without Kawhi: 1-3

Average margin in the wins is +27.7 and none of the losses have been especially close (a couple of the final scores are misleading). Their 2 clutch minutes are 3rd-fewest in the NBA.
